logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Horizontal bar chart for the WO-01 verification memo, rendered as an editable analytical SVG. Four horizontal bars on a common 0–60 kWh axis show measured energy on the shared fixed-duty acceptance run: P2 at 12 kWh (teal, labeled POLICY WINNER), P3 at 52, P1 at 56 and P4 at 58 kWh in muted gray-blue. Each row carries its trusted-table quality and defect values (q97 d1, q80 d3, q84 d4, q81 d0) and a verified gap annotation versus the leader (Δ +40, +44, +46 kWh). A lower panel restates the eligibility screen per candidate, showing pass status and defect margins (P1 margin 1 with retest caveat; P3 at the quality threshold; P4 margin 5). Footer states the unique minimum, the unused ID tie-break, and that cost, delivery and reliability are unverified. No hidden or coded content; all text is ordinary analytical prose.
